claim: Control-referenced score has a concurrent gait-severity association
Severity association is directionally stable to healthy-reference resampling
allowed_interpretation: Association did not depend on a small set of reference people

claim: Adding the score improves participant-level severity ranking beyond speed
result: +0.0474; positive in 98% of repeats; Pearson improved in 91%
allowed_interpretation: Reproducible improvement in relative severity ordering

claim: Better absolute clinical-score prediction is not established
result: -0.0069; lower RMSE in 66%; lower MAE in 44%; slope closer to 1 in 60%; intercept closer to 0 in 61%
allowed_interpretation: Ranking support is stronger than absolute-error support

claim: All frozen score inputs can be reconstructed from raw WearGait walkway data
allowed_interpretation: The reconstructed inputs were adequate for applying the frozen score in this release
prohibited_interpretation: Clinical validity or transport to another device

claim: The four-pass frozen score fails the six-plus-month stability criterion
allowed_interpretation: Observed scores were not qualified as stable across long intervals
No short-term reliability conclusion can be drawn
prohibited_interpretation: Calling the six-month result a short-term reliability failure

claim: Clinical responsiveness of the frozen score
sample_size: 93 audited participants; repeated session clinical anchors unavailable
estimand: Change in score against linked repeated clinical anchors
allowed_interpretation: Required session-specific anchors were not verified

claim: Full eight-input frozen-score transport to CARE-PD
estimand: All-eight analytical bridge then frozen-score validation
allowed_interpretation: Existing forward-translation analyses remain separate exploratory evidence

sample_size: One overlapping site; 16 target PD participants
allowed_interpretation: One holdout site provides limited transport evidence
prohibited_interpretation: General multisite calibration or broad transport

claim: Selected Mobilise-D features track within-person broad motor severity
result: Speed q=0.0046; stride length q=0.0017; cadence and stride time do not pass
allowed_interpretation: Speed and stride-length measures track the source broad motor anchor in this cohort
prohibited_interpretation: Validation of the WearGait eight-input score

claim: Mendeley supplies descriptive processed-table transport signals
sample_size: 42 cross-sectional; 10 longitudinal; 20 with repeated timing rows
result: Examples: speed rho=-0.656; stride amplitude rho=-0.617
confidence_interval: No bootstrap intervals or FDR in frozen cross-sectional table
allowed_interpretation: Descriptive transport signal requiring uncertainty and independent confirmation
prohibited_interpretation: Confirmed longitudinal responsiveness or medication effect
